title: Output of the relecture-scenario agent: the smallest corrections to an episode's screenplay

constats.description: Every real fault found while reading, even one you decide not to fix. Empty if the screenplay holds.

plans.description: References of the plans concerned, exactly as in the input (P01, P02…). May be empty for a missing resolution.

probleme.description: (French) The fault in one or two sentences, quoting the words that break it.

corrections.description: The SMALLEST corrections that remove the faults. Empty if nothing is broken.

plan.description: Reference of the plan concerned, exactly as in the input (P01, P02…).

description.description: (French) The COMPLETE new description of the plan: the original with only the broken sentence changed or one sentence added. Keep the rest word for word, the lines `NOM : « … »` and the final « État en fin de plan : … » sentence. No reference to another plan, no camera. Leave out if only `liaison` or `titre` changes.

titre.description: (French) A new title, only if the old one is now false.

liaison.description: The new link with the PREVIOUS plan, only if it changes. The first plan is always a coupe.

motif.description: (French) One sentence: why, pointing at the broken words.

plan.description: Reference of the plan to delete (a duplicated beat). Its lines must go to the plan that keeps the beat.

motif.description: (French) One sentence: why, and which plan keeps the beat.

secondes.description: The new generation duration, whole seconds.

motif.description: (French) One sentence: why (usually to keep the total on target after a cut or an addition).

apres.description: Reference of the plan AFTER which the new plan comes (the last plan, for a resolution).

titre.description: (French) Short title of the new plan.

description.description: (French) The new plan, in the screenplay's form: what happens and why, the lines if any (`NOM : « … »`), then « État en fin de plan : … ». With no camera and no reference to another plan.

motif.description: (French) One sentence: why this plan is needed.

notes.description: (French) A short remark: a fault left alone and why, or « à réécrire plutôt qu'à relire » if the episode needs more than 8 corrections. Empty if nothing to report.
